decision: Retain mode 4 as an opt-in first-solution residual experiment with persistent C library caching; no production solver changes.
changes: Arithmetic interval intersection before scanning candidates; exact last-variable elimination as a consequence of the equality bounds.
Contiguous C arrays plus 64-bit domain/occupied masks; word operations skip holes, used values and candidates outside the interval.
No allocation, Python call, propagation queue, matching or persistent domain mutation inside the native search.
Unit signed coefficients avoid integer division; original modes 0-2 retain their visitor.
Content-keyed native library cache checks source, compiler identity, flags, platform and relevant environment; SHA256 verifies the stored binary.
One loaded library instance per cache path/content within each Python process; cross-process reuse avoids compilation. Per-residual preparation only supplies arrays.
timing_scope: Whole timing includes model/state construction, extraction, ctypes encoding, bounded native work and fallback. Excludes imports, compilation/cache loading, output and independent square validation. Cache timings include compiler identity lookup, integrity checks, loading/copying but not subprocess startup/imports.
semantic_limits: First-solution pure integer feasibility, one global ALLDIFF, sums/linear equalities and inequalities; original residual limits remain 32 variables,64 constraints,values 0..4095.
Mode 4 uses ascending numeric value order, whereas modes 2/3 preserve input order. Whole-solve gains combine pruning, search order and representation changes.

The 200000-work budget counts candidates after interval/occupied filtering in final modes 3/4; old mode 2 counts raw candidate attempts. Budget numbers and native visits are not equal-work measures across old/new algorithms.
Residual failure uses an aggregate cause, changing dom/wdeg failure weighting. Nodes exclude native candidate visits.
On sorted-domain replay, final modes 3 and 4 have exactly the same statuses, visits, leaves, solution counts and first witness, including budget exhaustion. This isolates the representation effect.
Neither SIMD nor tighter future-variable extrema excluding used values is implemented. Future bounds are static; filtering is applied only to the current enumerated variable.
No additional experiment on 20x20; prior trace never entered the <=20-variable switch. No demonstrated gain or complete solution there.
Persistent cache remains experimental and requires a working local cc compiler for identity validation. Binaries are not included in the evidence archive.
provenance: All measured stages preserve source snapshots; pilots are retained rather than substituted by confirmation results.
The first pilot whole batch may overlap brief correctness checks. Final whole timing is sequential and isolated from tests/compilation.
A preliminary replay invocation aborted before recording timings due to a keyword-only seed argument. The corrected invocation is pilot_replay.
Earlier residual study archive is immutable and used as the original C reference and replay feasibility oracle.
